brief:
Eighteen community organizations in Gaza announced the formation of a coordinating body for reconstruction, Shehab Wire reported. The move aims to unify local efforts and reject displacement and temporary solutions.

The civic framework groups are coordinating reconstruction strategy as Gaza faces extensive material damage from ongoing conflict. The coordination body represents an attempt by local civil society to centralize planning around permanent rebuilding rather than interim measures.
